title: Pacific
overview: A group of young travelers are stranded on an island in the Pacific where they struggle to escape an evil presence kept hidden from mankind for centuries.

1999, Novolakskoye village. A small detachment of militia and OMON forces with their own efforts for almost a day to hold back large-scale attacks of international gangs that invaded the territory of Dagestan.

title: Aibolit
overview: Aibolit, who has been sent to a five-star hotel for forced rest, learns from Chi-Chi, a pet monkey, that an epidemic has begun among animals in Africa. Together with Chi-Chi, he goes to Africa in a hot air balloon, which takes tourists. Together they learn that the epidemic is the machinations of the evil robber Barmaley, who cannot deny his little daughter Leia anything.

title: Manyunya: Childhood of the Ba. In Cinema
overview: To transform her home village of Berd into a town, Roza and her father resort to a ruse. But this new status brings major changes to the settlement, along with disgruntled residents and a stern leader. When a childhood prank causes everything to spiral out of control, Roza must save not only her father but also the future of Berd.

title: Petrov and Vasechkin: Heroes of Our Time
overview: Petrov, Vasechkin and Masha go on an excursion to Lermontov places in Pyatigorsk. Having met their old friend, the Strange Janitor, the trio gets... into the nineteenth century! Friends decide that this is their chance to save the life of the legendary poet and prevent a fatal duel. This is how the newest, ordinary and incredible adventures of Petrov and Vasechkin in the Caucasus mountains begin.
